input.quote: "CUSTOMER(S)" means one or more customers of the Corio Services having its principal executive offices in the Territory who obtains a sublicense from Corio to use the Software or MarketSite.net Service, in the Corio Market Segment.
input.rationale: There is no express covenant not to compete, but the "Corio Market Segment" definition (customers with annual sales revenue under USD 1,000,000,000) operates as a field-of-use restriction on the customers we may serve with the hosted Software, reinforced by the North America Territory limit. Our position is no field-of-use restriction on Customer; we have deleted the segment limit, with the fallback of retaining the threshold plus the existing growth/M&A carve-out and a notice-based right to serve larger customers.

input.quote: Under no circumstances shall Commerce One contact Corio Customers regarding a non-ASP license sale, unless requested to do so by Corio.
input.rationale: All licences are non-exclusive and there is no obligation on us to source hosted procurement software only from Commerce One, to route customers exclusively through it, or to refrain from procuring from third parties; Exhibit D cooperation is expressly non-binding. The only channel restraint (Section 2.4) runs in our favour, which is acceptable.
